HGTECH.why: Makes 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers for AI data centers (Thailand and Wuhan capacity, 800G LPO in volume at a North American customer); its stock benefits directly from optical interconnect demand.
HGTECH.evidence: HGTECH investor Q&A (09-22-2026): Thailand phase-1 monthly capacity 20 ten-thousand units (1.6T ~2, 800G ~18 ten-thousand); Wuhan to reach 800G 80-100 ten-thousand and 1.6T 20 ten-thousand per month by year-end.

players.product: 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers (incl. 800G LPO) on in-house silicon photonics chips; 3.2T / 6.4T NPO engines in customer testing

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: overseas (Thailand) phase-1 monthly capacity is 20 ten-thousand transceivers, of which about 2 ten-thousand 1.6T and about 18 ten-thousand 800G; phase 2 adds nearly 100 mu of land with plant construction expected to finish in H2 next year. In Wuhan (Future City campus) 800G and 1.6T capacity is being built this year: by year-end monthly capacity can reach 80-100 ten-thousand 800G and 20 ten-thousand 1.6T.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand: 20 ten-thousand units/month (1.6T ~2, 800G ~18 ten-thousand); Wuhan year-end: 800G 80-100 ten-thousand/month, 1.6T 20 ten-thousand/month
